decisionBox.changed: The morning frame was run over. Position stays ADD but the tilt flips from bullish to BEARISH and confidence eases from 6.50 to 6.00. Four things changed. Open interest did NOT stop falling - it dropped another 142,698,779 USD to 2,209,357,909 - and the long/short account ratio DID cross 1.00, running 0.96, 1.00, 1.02, 1.03, 1.06, 1.04 through the afternoon. The crowded side has flipped from shorts to longs, exactly the condition the morning flagged as the one that would kill the upside case. Three: the liquidation map inverted with it. Longs now account for 13,614,671 USD of realised liquidation against 5,218,186 for shorts, a 2.61:1 LONG-dominant ratio, where the morning measured 4.73:1 the other way. Four - and this is why the call is range rather than bearish - the damage is contained. Price is still above every 4H EMA and above the 1H EMA100 and EMA200, the 4H MACD histogram is still positive at +235.87, the 68 percent retracement at 78,650 held on the first touch, and 15m momentum has already turned back up with the histogram at +73.83. calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates: 9 correct out of the last 10 evaluated sessions. Both morning gates were right - the 80,450.0 reduce fired ahead of a further 803.3-point decline, and the 81,450.0 add gate refused to arm into what turned out to be the top. The single failure in the window remains the 03 September midday add gate placed below an untested high.
calibration.note: The morning frame resolved decisively and in the report's favour. The 80,450.0 reduce gate FIRED: the 12:00 UTC hour settled 79,453.3, 996.7 points through the level, and there was no ambiguity about wick versus close this time - the entire bar collapsed. Price then fell a further 803.3 points to 78,650.0 at 14:00 UTC, so the gate bought real protection on path even though the mark has since recovered to 79,458.2, only 4.9 points above where the gate fired. That is the honest scale of the edge: acting helped, but it helped by removing exposure through an 803-point drawdown, not by getting a better price. The 81,450.0 add gate did NOT arm - the session high was 81,346.0, 104.0 points short - and that refusal was worth far more than the reduce, because arming it would have bought the exact high. The morning also recommended NO resting stop, which was correct: any stop near 80,450 would have been swept by an hourly bar that traded 2,174 points of range. Both explicit watch items the morning handed forward broke bearish and on schedule - open interest kept falling (-142,698,779 USD) and the long/short account ratio crossed 1.00 to 1.04. The discretionary side lost: the morning ADD bought 12 USDT of spot at 81,172.3 which now marks 79,458.2, -2.11 percent, roughly -0.25 USDT on the size.
